cands.name: Rodger M. Smitherman

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama State Senate for District 18 since 1994. Attorney who earned a B.B.A. from the University of Montevallo and a J.D. from Miles Law School. Lives in Birmingham.
cands.gaps: We could not find where he was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no stated positions or documented actions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, land buying by out-of-state or foreign buyers, growth and land protection, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His Ballotpedia page lists no endorsements for 2026, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. We found no news coverage of controversies and no information on foreign ties.

qual.background: Alabama State Senator for District 18 since 1994 (about 32 years), practicing attorney, with a J.D. from Miles Law School. Past committee assignments include Finance and Taxation Education and Judiciary, including ranking-member roles.
qual.why: He has more than three decades of prior legislative service plus a law career, which fits the top band for writing law and the budget. Committee roles were not counted toward the score.
